description: This file defines the CredentialsService interface, which specifies methods for retrieving device credentials within an Eclipse Hono-based system. It includes method signatures for fetching credentials with support for tracing spans and client context.

classes.name: CredentialsService
classes.description: Interface for a service managing device credentials, including methods to get credentials with optional tracing span and client context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a device based on tenant, type, and authId, with default NoopSpan for tracing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials with specified tracing span.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials based on tenant, type, authId, and client connection context, with default NoopSpan.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials with specified client context and tracing span.

calls: get(String, String, String, JsonObject, Span, Handler)
